intro: From 9 articles published between April 22 and May 18, 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of path-traversal vulnerabilities highlights critical risks across government, technology, and consumer IoT sectors. The most severe CVEs include CVE-2026-40050 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-45230 (CVSS 9.1), CVE-2024-1708 (CVSS 8.4), CVE-2026-6282 (CVSS 8.1), and CVE-2026-7819 (CVSS 8.1). The reporting spans global regions, with a focus on North America and the United States, and features a severity mix of three critical and six high-severity vulnerabilities.
